text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, you're amazing! You've really<n>improved
since last year!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was electrifying! I watched the<n>whole thing
with bated breath!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank ya, thank ya! Was that exciting<n>enough for
y'all?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't plan on stopping anytime<n>soon! I'm
gonna keep on runnin'<n>just like this!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! G1 sprint number two in the<n>bag!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I could see everybody's eyes shining<n>clear as day!
Ain't no doubt they<n>were lovin' me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: These legs of mine ain't done yet!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're done here, I've got<n>an inkling about
what our next race is<n>gonna be!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we're going to wrap up the<n>year with the
same race as last<n>year—the battle to decide the fall
King<n>of the Mile...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaaaw! It's finally here! The race<n>for the King of
the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna rule as king of the springand the fall!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ain't nobody gonna steal my throne!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the lofty goal of total domination<n>over the G1
dual miles and the fall G1<n>sprint, Taiki Shuttle turns
her focus to<n>the Mile Championship!
